correctness.rationale: A complete proof reconstructs Toeplitz norm equality, the published continuous constant-modulus membership characterization, and nonvanishing continuous approximation. For the explicit smooth chirp, flatness of its amplitude defeats all polynomial derivative growth of exp(i/t); a best approximant would have radius one-half and contradict continuity along an opposite-phase sequence. The quantitative upper bound uses an explicit cutoff with error no more than one-half plus epsilon and variation at most one/s minus 1/(2pi-s) plus pi. For every alpha<1, the lower-bound angular confinement on amplitude at least epsilon^alpha forces variation at least one/s_alpha minus 1/pi minus 4pi/3; the limits yield exactly one-half. No finite sampling is used as proof.
